notes: This file is local reference data for manufacturing planning and dimension sanity checks only.
It is never used to send print jobs, discover printers over LAN/USB, connect to a printer, or connect to any manufacturer cloud.
Always verify printer specs against the manufacturer/physical unit before trusting a hard pass/fail on build volume.
This fleet list is expected to change; add, remove, or edit printer entries here as hardware changes rather than assuming it is fixed.
